structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a pump.fun token (it has migrated to PumpSwap) that is named after the well-known X account @PsyopAnime, which has about 200k followers and posts AI satirical anime. The description reads "Fees to @PsyopAnime via UsePaid", so it is a fee-sharing token that uses a creator's name, launched by a factory wallet that GMGN says has launched 18,793 tokens. It is not the project's own token. The established PsyopAnime token (2nP9…pump, about $614k market cap, $172k liquidity) already exists. This copy peaked near a $96k market cap, is down about 30% over 6 hours, and is bouncing hard on the 5-minute chart (+125%) at about $32k market cap. Several other same-name clones launched within minutes of it and are already dead.

narrative.description: The PsyopAnime AI satirical anime brand is real and has an audience: about 200k followers, a past Elon Musk follow that pushed its token to $26M, and a Solana community. The linked post (status 2103673850688917928) is probably a recent PsyopAnime post that someone turned into a fee-share coin. I could not read the post (X returned HTTP 402).
narrative.why_spreading: Someone likely launched a fee-share coin off a fresh PsyopAnime post, and the name alone pulled in bots and degens. After an early high of about $96k it faded, and the current bounce looks like a dead-cat bounce or bot rotation rather than new news.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the only clone with volume, and it routes fees to @PsyopAnime via UsePaid. That is a third-party fee-share wrapper, not a launch by the project, and I found no sign that @PsyopAnime endorsed it.
token_connection.competing_tokens: The canonical PsyopAnime token 2nP9yKQNSGQy851iyawDvBkzkK2R2aqKArQCKc2gpump (about $614k market cap, $172k liquidity), plus at least five dead same-name clones launched today.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 495 bundler wallets, 427 fresh wallets, 33 snipers, a 57% bot/degen rate and 32% held by the top 70 snipers. The dev wallet has launched 18,793 tokens. Against that, 1,095 unique buyers in 6 hours and 42 smart wallets suggest some real degen trading. I found no organic posts mentioning this contract.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see the X post or any replies, so I cannot say whether @PsyopAnime acknowledged the coin.

structural_risks: The dev wallet is a mass launcher (18,793 tokens), and GMGN puts the dev/team hold rate at 17.7%
Heavy bundler and sniper presence (top 70 snipers hold 32%)
Only about $15k of liquidity, so the price moves sharply
A bigger canonical token absorbs anyone who actually wants PsyopAnime exposure
The price is 65% below its high, leaving overhead supply from earlier buyers

structured_output.counterargument: PsyopAnime is a real brand with a large following. If @PsyopAnime quote-posts or accepts the fee-share (UsePaid claims), the coin could quickly re-test its $96k high, which is roughly 3x from here. The mint is renounced and the LP is burned, so the pool cannot simply be pulled, and a +125% 5-minute bounce shows buyers are coming back.

source_coverage.notes: A search for the contract address returned nothing relevant. Search results confirm the PsyopAnime brand and that the canonical token exists. The linked X post returned HTTP 402. Discord was not searched and psyopanime.ai was not opened; the news I found was about the canonical token, not this clone.

structured_output.thesis: This is a third-party fee-share clone of an established brand that already has a canonical token. It was launched by a mass-launcher wallet, has heavy bundler and sniper activity, and has already faded 65% from its high. The current bounce gives it some chance of a short squeeze, but its chances of doubling are below those of a typical coin in this pool.
